learning_outcomes.text: Develop the ability to understand the transformation process of digital art by recognizing the concept of NFT.
Develop the ability to track and verify digital assets by understanding NFT technology and the role of blockchain.
Develop the ability to evaluate the commercial value of digital art by analyzing the NFT market and ecosystem.
Develop the ability to evaluate the effects of NFT on the art world.
Develop the ability to produce solutions to problems related to the protection and use of digital art by understanding the legal and ethical dimensions of NFT.

syllabus_topics: Introduction and Course Presentation, Definition and importance of NFT concept, Course objectives and goals, Introduction of course materials and resources
Transformation of Digital Art, History and development of digital art, Uniqueness and ownership concepts of digital assets, Impact of NFT on digital artworks
Blockchain Technology and NFT, Basic principles of blockchain technology, How NFTs are created and tracked on the blockchain, Role of blockchain in providing reliability and verification for NFTs
NFT Platforms and Market, Introduction and analysis of popular NFT platforms, Dynamics and trends of the NFT market, NFT buying and selling processes and pricing strategies
Art and NFT, Effects and discussions of NFT in the art world, Digitalization of artworks and accessibility issues, Impact of NFT on the commercial value of artworks
Legal and Ethical Dimensions of NFT, Copyrights and protection of NFTs, Forgery and security issues in the NFT market, Ethical issues and solutions in NFT usage
NFT and Music Industry, Impacts and opportunities of NFT in the music industry, Presentation and sale of music works as NFTs, Advantages and challenges of NFT for music artists
NFT and Sports Industry, Applications of NFT in the sports industry, Presentation and commercialization of sports collections as NFTs, Benefits and issues of NFT for athletes and teams
NFT and Gaming Industry, Use of NFTs in the gaming world and game economy, NFT-ification and tracking of in-game assets, Potential impacts of NFT for players and game companies
NFT and Communities, Impact of NFTs on community interaction and participation, NFT usage in art, music, sports, or gaming communities, Community-based NFT projects and collective creativity
NFT and Sustainability, Energy consumption and environmental impacts of NFTs, Sustainable NFT projects and solutions, Role of NFT in the future of sustainable digital art
NFT and Changing Economic Models, Impact of NFTs on economic models and revenue sharing, NFT revenue model for artists, musicians, or athletes, Relationship of NFTs with decentralized finance (DeFi)

Future of NFT and Advanced Applications, Future potential and developments of NFT technology, Innovative NFT applications and examples, Opportunity for students to design and present their own NFT projects
